ID: `ui-screenshot`.

## What it does

Defines a matrix of pages, states, viewports, density, theme and provenance. Reaches the actual state and verifies that relevant content, authentication and consent are ready; unwanted loaders or errors fail the capture. The driver saves raw PNGs, framed images and a manifest with route, revision, timestamp, dimensions and checksum. Each framed image is opened and checked before delivery.

## When to use it

Use it explicitly to document a visual version, compare changes or prepare images for Figma. A screenshot demonstrates rendering of the shown state; behaviors require separate verification.

## How to use it

Ask for it by name, or invoke it with `/ui-screenshot` in Claude Code or `$ui-screenshot` in Codex. Specify the URL, states, viewports and archive destination. For a long page, choose viewport, full-page image or segments. Provide access to the required state and the source revision if historical. Request raw files and a manifest as well as final images.

## What it delivers

- Framed PNGs ready for presentation
- Raw PNGs under raw/
- Complete manifest with provenance and checks

## Example

Capture the project detail in its complete state on desktop and mobile. For the long page, use consecutive segments and preserve the revision, raw files and manifest.

## Prerequisites

- Requires a reachable app and the capture driver runtime; authentication and consent must be satisfied when applicable.
